company.name: Infosys
company.summary: Consulting, digital services and software platforms used by organisations around the world.
company.description: Infosys helps organisations change and operate their technology. Its work includes consulting, software development, cloud, artificial intelligence, engineering and business-process services.
company.money: Clients pay for projects, managed services and software platforms. Revenue depends on client spending and delivery, while employee costs, pricing, utilisation and currency movements influence margins.
company.ownership: This profile covers Infosys Limited and its consolidated businesses. Infosys is separate from other Indian technology companies, even when they serve similar clients.
watch: Are customers starting, expanding or delaying technology programmes?
How much contracted work is converting into revenue?
How effectively do pricing, utilisation and employee costs balance?
risks: Large customers can postpone discretionary technology work.
Hiring, retention and wages influence delivery capacity and margins.
AI and automation can alter demand, pricing and the skills clients require.
update: AI, cloud and core services belong in one picture
The official portfolio spans consulting and delivery services as well as platforms such as Finacle. A single AI announcement does not describe the full business.
company.question: Does every large contract announced by Infosys become revenue immediately?
company.answer: No. Revenue is generally recognised as work is delivered. Contract value, timing and reported revenue describe different stages.
company.productNote: Major official brand, product and business-offering families reviewed in October 2026. This groups variants, pack sizes, models, formulations or service subtypes where listing each one would obscure the company overview.
